title: When the Oath Sings Revisited
premise: Marguerite Ravensworth has spent her life memorizing the Thornfell passes for the Cartographers' Oath, a guild sworn to keep the mortal realm and the fading realm of Vaelthorn sealed apart. When a dying stranger presses a living map into her hands, she discovers the covenant binding the realms was broken decades ago — by her own guild, to save itself from extinction — and the map is the last key to reforging it. Hunted by oathbreakers who profit from the breach, and guided by the stranger's lingering voice inside the map, Marguerite must choose between the loyalty she owes her guild and the truth that will destroy it. In the end she sings the broken covenant whole at the cost of her own memories of the roads she loves, becoming the new map herself and sealing the realms with the guild's guilt written plainly upon its final page.
about_author: Ulyana Galloway is the pen name of a former mountain guide who traded trail maps for story maps after a winter spent snowed in with nothing but folklore and ink. Her work is known for landscapes that behave like characters and oaths that refuse to stay quiet.

chapters.title: The Last Cartographer's Daughter
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. She guides one final smuggling run through the Thornfell passes, revealing her encyclopedic knowledge of the roads and the guild's dwindling, desperate state. Emotional beat: pride shadowed by grief for a dying tradition, ending with her refusal to take a stranger's dying warning seriously.

chapters.title: Ink That Breathes
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. A wounded stranger collapses at her door and presses a living map into her hands, its ink crawling like veins, before dying with the guild's seal on his lips. Emotional beat: dread and reluctant responsibility as the map begins whispering routes she never drew.

chapters.title: What the Guild Buried
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV, with a flashback chapter from her mentor Corvane thirty years prior. She confronts Corvane, who admits the guild broke the covenant to survive a purge, letting Vaelthorn bleed into the mountains. Emotional beat: betrayal; the flashback shows a young Corvane making the choice with trembling, justifying hands.

chapters.title: Roads That Remember
chapters.summary: The map's voice — the stranger, Edran — speaks to Marguerite as she travels, and familiar passes begin reshaping themselves, remembering Vaelthorn. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into unease as her greatest expertise becomes unreliable, and Edran's charm masks his own guilt.

chapters.title: The Oathbreakers' Toll
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Guild enforcers, led by her childhood friend Sable, ambush her at a bridge; the guild wants the map destroyed and the secret kept. Emotional beat: heartbreak of loyalty weaponized, ending with Sable letting her go — one act of mercy neither can afford.

chapters.title: Vaelthorn's Hollow Choir
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV, crossing into the fading realm. She finds a realm starving for memory, its people singing fragments of stolen mortal roads to stay whole. Emotional beat: compassion and horror; she realizes every guild map is a wound dressed as a masterpiece.

chapters.title: The Price Written in Margins
chapters.summary: Edran's POV at last: he was the cartographer who drew the living map, and reforging the covenant demands a life's worth of memory as ink. Emotional beat: confession and self-loathing, revealing he chose Marguerite not at random but because her memory of the roads is the richest left alive.

chapters.title: Storm Over the Sealed Gate
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV. Corvane and the guild arrive to kill her at the covenant gate as Vaelthorn begins collapsing into Thornfell; Sable turns against the guild to defend her. Emotional beat: chaos and resolve — Marguerite stops running and chooses truth over every loyalty she was raised on.

chapters.title: When the Oath Sings
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV, the climax. She sings the covenant whole, feeding it the map of every road she knows, as Edran's voice frays into silence and Corvane watches his life's lie dissolve. Emotional beat: sacrifice and terrible beauty — the mountains knit closed, and her memories begin to empty.

chapters.title: A Blank Map, and a New Hand
chapters.summary: Marguerite's POV, epilogue. She survives with no memory of the roads, only a guild ledger that now records the truth of the breach, and Sable teaching her the passes again from the honest page. Emotional beat: bittersweet renewal — she cannot remember why the mountains matter, only that they do.
